title: Camping in the Promised Land
textBlocks:
Hello Bravehearts, in today’s lesson
you will hear about kings, 
bread from heaven and passover

The Kings were scared, they had heard what God had done for the Israelites
at the Jordan River

The kings heard that God had stopped the river, 
so that all the people could cross on dry land.
The Kings knew that God was powerful and He was the Lord of the Israelites
And that meant trouble for them
Their hearts melted in fear
Using a food colouring pen, draw scared faces on marshmallows

Now that they were in the promised land and out of the desert
The Lord STOPPED sending bread from heaven (manna)
Because the promised land was not a desert - it was a land flowing with milk and honey
THAT MEANT THAT THEY MUST BE PLANTS FOR COWS TO EAT AND FLOWERS FOR BEES
very diffferent to a sandy desert.

They also had their first passover in the promised land
So that they could remember how God saved them from death

When Jesus was at the LAST SUPPER - he ate the PASSOVER meal 
and that is when He told his friends to REMEMBER HIM
When the eat bread - they must remember His body 
and when they drink wine - they must remember His blood
This is how God saved US from death

Dear Lord Jesus 
Thank you for dying on the cross to save me
Thank you that I can live with you one day in heaven.
Please help me to be strong and brave
Amen
